pageSubtitle: Click commits on the DAG to select Source → Destination. Predicts the result.

revision.label: Single revision
revision.desc: Move only the selected commit. Children reconnect to original parent.

subtree.label: Subtree
subtree.desc: Move the commit and all its descendants together.

branch.label: Branch
branch.desc: Move the entire branch (traces back to common ancestor).

selection.selectSourceHint: Click a commit to select Source
selection.selectDestHint: Click a commit to select Destination

jjConflict.title: jj conflicts
jjConflict.resolveAnytime: Can be resolved at any time
jjConflict.workOnOther: Can work on other commits first

resolution.title: Resolution steps
resolution.step2: Edit conflict markers in the files to resolve

revision.move: Moves {{source}} on top of {{dest}}. Original child commits are reconnected to {{source}}'s parent.
revision.alreadyChild: {{source}} is already a child of {{dest}}. No change.

subtree.move: Moves {{source}} and its descendants together on top of {{dest}}. Parent-child relationships within the subtree are preserved.
subtree.alreadyChild: {{source}} is already a child of {{dest}}. No change.

branch.move: Moves the entire branch containing {{source}} on top of {{dest}}. Traces back to the common ancestor.

predict.conflictExplanation:
{{source}} and {{dest}} are not in an ancestor-descendant relationship, so conflicts may occur if they modify the same files.

Note: This is a heuristic prediction. Actual conflicts depend on file contents.

validation.sameSrcDest: Source and Destination are the same. No move needed.
validation.cycle: Destination is a descendant of Source. Cannot rebase as it would create a cycle.
